tagline: Achieve financial independence to realize your ambitions
hero_kpi_rationale: Fee-based revenue is the primary driver of SoFi's structural growth, increasing 59% in 2025, driven by the Loan Platform, interchange, and brokerage platforms, marking a shift toward a more recurring and less cyclical model.

kpis.name: Fee-Based Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from fees (origination, interchange, brokerage, etc.), not from interest.
kpis.description: Fee-based revenue reached a record $1.5B in 2025, up from $969.9M in 2024, driven by Loan Platform, interchange fees, and brokerage activities.
kpis.signal: Explosive growth of +59% in 2025, demonstrating the rising strength of the recurring revenue model.

kpis.name: Total Net Revenue
kpis.explanation: Sum of interest income and fee-based revenue.
kpis.description: Total net revenue reached $3.6B in 2025, up 35% from 2024, supported by both interest and fee revenue drivers.
kpis.signal: 35% growth in 2025, the strongest in the company's history.

kpis.name: Net Interest Income
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from loans issued, net of funding costs.
kpis.description: Net interest income reached $2.2B in 2025, up 29%, driven by growth in average loan balances.
kpis.signal: Solid 29% growth, fueled by expansion of the loan portfolio.

kpis.name: Interchange Fee Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue earned on each transaction made with the SoFi card.
kpis.description: Interchange fees surged 71% in 2025, reflecting a significant increase in member spending via card and account.
kpis.signal: Explosion of +71%, indicating growing adoption of SoFi cards and SoFi Money accounts.

kpis.name: Loan Platform Fees
kpis.explanation: Fees earned for loan origination and servicing on behalf of partners.
kpis.description: The platform generated $575.9M in fees in 2025 through the origination of $11B in loans for third parties, a high-margin business model.
kpis.signal: $575.9M generated in 2025, evidence of the scalability of the B2B model.

kpis.name: Net Interest Margin
kpis.explanation: Difference between interest rate earned on loans and cost of deposits, expressed as a percentage.
kpis.description: Net interest margin improved from 5.80% in 2024 to 5.85% in 2025, reflecting efficient funding cost management.
kpis.signal: Stable improvement to 5.85% in 2025, despite a volatile rate environment.

kpis.name: Total Deposits
kpis.explanation: Total client deposits held in SoFi accounts, a stable source of funding.
kpis.description: Deposits reached $37.5B at end-2025, up $11.5B during the year, reducing reliance on market-based financing.
kpis.signal: 44% growth, strengthening the model's resilience and profitability.

kpis.name: Total Members
kpis.explanation: Number of active customers on the SoFi platform.
kpis.description: Total members reached 13.6 million at end-2025, growing rapidly due to the integrated product offering and brand strength.
kpis.signal: 13.6 million members at end-2025, +35% year-on-year, evidence of strong traction.

kpis.name: Financial Services Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue from the segment including SoFi Money, card, crypto, brokerage, etc.
kpis.description: The Financial Services segment grew revenue from $821.5M to $1.542B in 2025, driven by fee growth and adoption of daily-use products.
kpis.signal: Explosion of +88% in 2025, the primary engine of total revenue growth.

kpis.name: Loan Platform Volume
kpis.explanation: Total loan volume placed or transferred via the B2B platform.
kpis.description: SoFi placed over $15.6B in loans (personal, student, mortgage) via its platform in 2025, strong year-on-year growth.
kpis.signal: $15.6B in 2025, +57%, proof of the scalability of the B2B model.

risks.title: Economic Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to economic fluctuations, including changes in interest rates and macroeconomic conditions

risks.title: Credit Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to the risk of borrower default, particularly on personal and student loans

risks.title: Regulatory Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to strict regulations, particularly regarding student lending and consumer protection

risks.title: Competitive Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a competitive market, particularly in personal and student lending

risks.title: Interest Rate Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to fluctuations in interest rates, which can impact its financial results

risks.title: Liquidity Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company must manage its liquidity to meet financial obligations

risks.title: Reputation Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to reputational damage, particularly in the event of payment defaults or regulatory non-compliance

ai_positioning.summary: No significant mention of artificial intelligence, machine learning, or related technologies was found in SoFi's 10-K filing.
